newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Truck with 41 refugees stopped on German border.
newsitem.headline: Truck with 41 refugees stopped on German border.

text.p: German border police early on Friday stopped a truck trying to smuggle 41 ethnic Albanians from Kosovo, Yugoslavia, across the Austrian border into Germany, Austrian police said.
"German police found 41 Kosovo-Albanians in a truck at 2.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) at the border town of Suben," a spokesman said.
The truck was officially carrying armchairs from Hungary and had passed through customs control on the Austro-Hungarian border without problem.
The spokesman said there were 40 men and one woman in the truck trying to enter Germany illegally. They would be sent back to Hungary, where they boarded the truck, as soon as possible, he added.
The incident comes just four days after 51 Kurds were discovered hidden in a Turkish lorry as it tried to cross into Bavaria from Neuhaus in the western province of Upper Austria.
